preconditions.description: The number of employees n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of dislike relationships m is between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in dislikes)
preconditions.description: Each dislike relationship (a_i, b_i) involves distinct employees within the range 1 to n.
The number of salary revisions q is between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n for v_i in revisions)
preconditions.description: Each salary revision v_i targets an employee within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output contains q + 1 integers, one for each day including the initial day.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(day_triples, int) and day_triples >= 0 for day_triples in result)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is a non-negative integer representing the number of dangerous triples on that day.
